general.title: Credentials
general.credentialsAlert: All credentials must be configured on sales channel level.
general.doubleoptinAlert: Lists are set to double opt-in by default in all Klaviyo accounts. Be careful that you do not have double opt-in enabled in Shopware and Klaviyo at the same time!

initialization.label: Initialize Klaviyo After First Interaction With Page.
initialization.helpText: Delays loading Klaviyo's tracking until a visitor first interacts with the page (for example, by scrolling), which can help your page load faster. Once loaded, it stays active for the rest of their visit.

scheduledSync.title: Scheduled Sync
scheduledSync.salesChannelAlert: To configure these settings, switch the sales channel selector to "All Sales Channels".

enabled.label: Enable Account
enabled.helpText: Turn this on to activate your Klaviyo integration for this sales channel.

privateApiKey.label: Klaviyo Private API key
privateApiKey.helpText: Your Klaviyo Private API Key, used to securely send data to Klaviyo. You'll find it in Klaviyo under Settings > API Keys.

publicApiKey.label: Klaviyo Public API key
publicApiKey.helpText: Your Klaviyo Public API Key (also called Site ID), used by the tracking code on your storefront. You'll find it in Klaviyo under Settings > API Keys.

klaviyoListForSubscribersSync.label: Klaviyo List for subscribers sync
klaviyoListForSubscribersSync.helpText: Choose the list in Klaviyo that your shop's newsletter subscribers will be added to.

bisVariantField.label: Product identification field mapping
bisVariantField.helpText: Choose how products are identified in the data sent to Klaviyo: by Product Number (the SKU your customers see) or by Product ID (Shopware's internal identifier). Product Number is recommended for most shops.

orderIdentification.label: Order identification field mapping
orderIdentification.helpText: Choose how orders are identified in the data sent to Klaviyo: by Order Number (the number shown to customers, e.g. on invoices) or by Order ID (Shopware's internal identifier).

cookieConsent.label: Cookie Consent
cookieConsent.helpText: Choose which cookie consent tool decides whether Klaviyo is allowed to track a visitor's activity in their browser. Select "Nothing" to always allow tracking, or choose the tool your shop uses so Klaviyo only tracks visitors who gave their consent.
cookieConsent.scopeNotice: This setting only affects storefront tracking that happens directly in the customer's browser, such as Added to Cart and Viewed Product.

trackDeletedAccountOrders.label: Track Deleted Account's Orders
trackDeletedAccountOrders.helpText: By default, orders are skipped and not sent to Klaviyo if the associated customer account has since been deleted. Enable this to send them anyway. Note: since the deleted account can no longer be matched to an existing Klaviyo profile, Klaviyo may create a new, separate profile instead of updating the customer's original one.

trackViewedProduct.label: Track Viewed Product
trackViewedProduct.helpText: Sends Klaviyo an event whenever a customer views a product page. Klaviyo can use this to power "you viewed this" reminder emails and personalized recommendations.

trackRecentlyViewedItems.label: Track Recently Viewed Items
trackRecentlyViewedItems.helpText: Lets Klaviyo build a "recently viewed products" history for each customer, which can be used for personalized recommendations in emails and on your site.

trackAddedToCart.label: Track Added to Cart
trackAddedToCart.helpText: Sends Klaviyo an event when a logged-in customer adds a product to their cart. This is what powers abandoned cart emails. Note: only tracked for customers who are logged in. Also included when you run a historical sync.

trackStartedCheckout.label: Track Started Checkout
trackStartedCheckout.helpText: Sends Klaviyo an event when a logged-in customer reaches the checkout page. Commonly used to trigger abandoned checkout reminder emails. Also included when you run a historical sync.

trackPlacedOrder.label: Track Placed Order
trackPlacedOrder.helpText: Sends Klaviyo an event when a customer completes an order. Used for order confirmation flows and to build purchase history. Also included when you run a historical sync.

trackOrderedProduct.label: Track Ordered Product
trackOrderedProduct.helpText: Sends Klaviyo a separate event for each product in a completed order. Klaviyo can use this for post-purchase flows, such as cross-sell or replenishment reminders. Also included when you run a historical sync.

trackFulfilledOrder.label: Track Fulfilled Order
trackFulfilledOrder.helpText: Sends Klaviyo an event when an order's status changes to Completed in Shopware. Also included when you run a historical sync.

trackCancelledOrder.label: Track Cancelled Order
trackCancelledOrder.helpText: Sends Klaviyo an event when an order's status changes to Cancelled in Shopware. Also included when you run a historical sync.

trackRefundedOrder.label: Track Refunded Order
trackRefundedOrder.helpText: Sends Klaviyo an event when a payment on an order is refunded. Also included when you run a historical sync.

trackPaidOrder.label: Track Paid Order
trackPaidOrder.helpText: Sends Klaviyo an event when a payment on an order is marked as paid or partially paid. Also included when you run a historical sync.

trackShippedOrder.label: Track Shipped Order
trackShippedOrder.helpText: Sends Klaviyo an event when an order's shipping status changes to shipped or partially shipped. Also included when you run a historical sync.

trackSubscribedToBackInStock.label: Track Back In Stock
trackSubscribedToBackInStock.helpText: Turn this on to show a sign-up form on product pages for out-of-stock products that have the "Clearance Sale" option enabled. Customers can leave their email to be notified by Klaviyo as soon as the product is back in stock.

oldJobCleanup.label: Enable cleanup of old jobs
oldJobCleanup.helpText: Automatically removes old, completed synchronization tasks from the overview once they reach the age you choose below, so the overview stays clean and easy to read.

apiValidation.listNotExistMessage: In Klaviyo a List that corresponds with the Public key provided is not found!

excludedSubscribersSynchronization.label: Enable Daily Excluded Subscribers Synchronization
excludedSubscribersSynchronization.helpText: Once a day, we check Klaviyo for customers who have unsubscribed from marketing emails there, and automatically update their newsletter status in your shop to match. This keeps your shop and Klaviyo in sync.

withoutSubscribersSync.label: Enable Synchronization Customers Without Subscription
withoutSubscribersSync.helpText: Only takes effect when you use the button below to sync your subscribers. When you do, it also sends Klaviyo profiles for customers who are not subscribed to your newsletter — without this option, only subscribed customers are included.

withoutOrdersSync.label: Enable Synchronization Customers Without Orders
withoutOrdersSync.helpText: Only takes effect when you use the button below to sync your order history. When enabled, it also sends Klaviyo profiles for customers who have never placed an order — without this option, only customers with orders are included.

historicalEvents.scopeNotice: Select a date range to export historical events (like Order Placed or Order Shipped) to Klaviyo. Warning: This sync may trigger automated Klaviyo flows. Pause active flows before proceeding to avoid sending unintended emails to customers.

subscriberSync.scopeNotice: Triggers an immediate full sync of all active shop subscribers to your configured Klaviyo list. Warning: If Double Opt-In is enabled on your Klaviyo list, unconfirmed customers will automatically receive an opt-in email upon sync.
